payload.claim: `_read_holder` here is a line-for-line restatement of `saffron/home_lock.py`'s `_read_holder` (lines 45-53 there): same seek/readline/partition/int-parse logic, just renaming the `command` local to `holder_text`. CLAUDE.md's standing instruction to prefer importing a repo-defined helper over restating it (and this remit's 'one source' question) is not met: a person has to decide whether this parsing routine should be factored into one shared helper that both `home_lock.lock` and `cell_name_lock.lock` call, rather than kept as two independently-maintained copies of the same lock-file line format.
